🚨 IMPORTANT NOTICE TO ALL DAILY JOBS GOA READERS 🚨

Your trust means everything to us.

To ensure you receive accurate, authentic, and verified job updates, please note that Daily Jobs Goa is officially available only on the following platforms:

🌐 Official Website
📸 Official Instagram Page
👍 Official Facebook Page
💬 Official WhatsApp Channel

Our official logo is displayed consistently across all these platforms to help you identify our genuine accounts.

We have noticed that some social media pages are reposting our job posters and carousel posts, including content containing our watermark. While public content may be shared by others, such pages are not affiliated with or managed by Daily Jobs Goa unless they are one of our official platforms.

⚠️ Please verify job updates only through our official channels. Be cautious before sharing personal information, making payments, or responding to messages from unofficial accounts.

Thank you for your continued trust and support. We remain committed to providing reliable and timely job opportunities across Goa.

🛡️ Stay Safe. Stay Informed. Stay Connected.
Follow only our official Daily Jobs Goa platforms.

🚗 We're Hiring: Works Manager! 🚗

Chowgule Industries Goa's No. 1 Dealer for Maruti Suzuki Vehicles is looking for a talented individual to join their dynamic team at the Fatorda, Goa workshop!

Position: Works Manager

Location: Fatorda, Goa Workshop

Qualification: Diploma in Automobile / Mechanical Engineering

Experience & Skills: 3–4 years of experience in a similar or supervisory role in an automobile dealership, strong leadership and team-management skills, customer-centric approach, computer literate, excellent communication skills, and a strong team-player attitude.

Why Join Us?

* Reputed Company in Goa

* Excellent Growth Opportunities

* Professional Work Environment

📧 Interested candidates may send their latest CV to: govind@chowguleind.com

📞 Contact: 9011167788

#GoaJobs #MarutiSuzukiArena #ChowguleIndustries #WorksManager #automobilejobs
